nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person' · also printed after Waṅ-Qān-(n)u, 'of Wang Qan' (Ming 的), where the (n) is Shiratori's
jaγ̇un: jaγ̇un — what (interrogative pronoun) [甚麽] · also 'what' before a noun, 'what use' (Ming 有甚)
ögküi: ög- — to give; participle -küi, 'giving, the one who gives' (verb, participle; Ming 與的) [與的]
elčin-e: elčin — envoy, messenger; dative-locative -e, 'to the envoy' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [使臣 行]
keġeġesü: keġe- — to say; conditional -ġesü, 'if, when (he) says', closing a quotation (verb, conditional) [說呵]
žarliγ: žarliγ — command, decree (Ming 聖旨) (noun) [聖旨]
aqa-dur: aqa — elder brother (noun); dative-locative -dur, 'to, with' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [兄行]
ejetüžü: ejetü- — to consult, deliberate (stem inferred from the Ming 商量); converb -žü, 'consulting' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [商量着]
aqa-da: aqa — elder brother, the senior; dative-locative -da, 'to the elder brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form after a vowel; Ming 兄 行) [兄 行]
žarligi: žarliγ — command, decree (Ming 聖旨); the token left before the instrumental -jar in žarlig(i)-jar, 'according to the decree' (the (i) is Shiratori's) (noun) [聖旨 依着]
saγ̇ulba: saγu- — to sit; causative -l-, past -ba, 'seated (her)'; the Ming gives only 'sat' (verb, causative, past) [坐了]
saγ̇urin: saγ̇urin — a place for sitting, a post, a station (from saγ̇u- 'sit'; read from the Ming 坐位) (noun) [坐位]
toqučar: Toqučar — Toquchar, a man's name (name) [人名]
qojar-i: qojar — two; accusative -i, 'the two' as object (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇行) [兩箇行]
žasaγ̇ulžu: žasa- — to prepare, set in order; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'having (it) prepared' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form; Ming 敎整治着) [敎整治着]
saγ̇urin-dur: saγ̇urin — seat, place; dative-locative -dur, 'in the seat' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [位裏]
bolγaba: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + past -ba, 'made into, treated as' (verb, causative past) [做了]
dur: -dur — dative-locative: at, in (case suffix, back-vowel form; the token left after a hyphen; Ming 時 'time', 'at the time of') [時]
terged: tergen — cart, wagon (the n-stem; terge- before the plural -d); -d: plural (Ming 每) [車每]
bidan-ača: bida — we; -n-: stem-final n before a case ending; -ača: ablative: from (back-vowel form) [咱行]
kemlegsen: kemle- — to fix a limit, set a measure (from kem 'limit'); past participle -gsen, 'fixed, set' (verb, past participle) [限定了的]
qaγas: qaγas — separating (reading uncertain; perhaps qaγača- 'part' in a converb form) [分離] · also 'clear, plain' (Ming 分明; reading uncertain) [分明]
aldaltan: aldal — fault, penalty, fine; plural possessive -tan 'those having', 'those with faults' (noun + possessive) [罰有的(每)]
bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了] · also an auxiliary after a participle in -qu, -kü: bariqu bolba, kürgekü bolba, 'came to seize, came to lay on'
